spans.s: mf(आ)n. (perhaps fr. √ कृश्, and connected with कष्ट), causing trouble or pain, painful, attended with pain or labour, MBh.; R.; Pañcat.; Suśr.
being in a difficult or painful situation, R. ii, 78, 14
bad, evil, wicked, W.

(अस्, अम्), m. n. difficulty, trouble, labour, hardship, calamity, pain, danger (often ifc., e.g. वन-वासक्˚, the difficulties of living in a forest; मूत्र-क्˚, q.v.; अर्थ-कृच्छ्रेषु, in difficulties, in a miserable situation, MBh. iii, 65; Nal. xv, 3; प्राणकृच्छ्र, danger of life, MBh. ii, 6; BhP.), RV. x, 52, 4; Nir.; AitBr. &c.
ischury (= मूत्र-क्˚), L.
bodily mortification, austerity, penance, Gaut.; Mn. &c.
a particular kind of religious penance, Mn.; Yājñ.
(अस्), m. N. of Viṣṇu, MBh. xii, 12864
(in comp. with a perf. Pass. p. Pāṇ. ii, 1, 39; vi, 3, 2.)
(अम्), ind. miserably, painfully, with difficulty, R. iv, 22, 7
कृच्छ्˚रेण (एन or अ- in comp.) ind. instr. with difficulty, with great exertion, painfully, hardly, scarcely, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 33; R.; Suśr. &c. (अल्प-कृच्छ्रेण, ‘easily’, SaddhP.)
(आत्), ind. abl. id., MBh.; R. &c.
कृच्छ्र—कर्मन् n. a difficult act, difficulty, labour, Kathās.
कृच्छ्र—काल m. a season of difficulty or of danger, MBh. i.
कृच्छ्र—कृत् mfn. undergoing a penance, Yājñ. iii, 328.
कृच्छ्र—गत mfn. undergoing trouble or misery, suffering pain, distressed, MBh.; R.; Bhartṛ.
undergoing a penance, MBh.
कृच्छ्र—तस् ind. with difficulty, MBh. iii, 2036.
कृच्छ्र—ता f. painful or dangerous state (especially in disease), Suśr.
कृच्छ्र—द्वादश-रात्र m. N. of penance lasting twelve days, Āp.
कृच्छ्र—द्वितीय m. a friend in need, Car.
कृच्छ्र—पतित mfn. fallen into distress, Kathās.
कृच्छ्र—प्राण mfn. one whose life is in danger, hardly supporting life, MBh.; R.; BhP.
breathing with difficulty, W.
कृच्छ्र—भाज् mfn. encompassed with pain and distress, MBh. ii, 15, 2.
कृच्छ्र—भोजिन् mfn. undergoing austerities, MBh. xii, 1247.
कृच्छ्र—मूत्र-पुरीष-त्व n. difficulty in evacuating the bladder and intestines, Suśr.
कृच्छ्र—रूप mfn. being in difficulties, MBh. iii, 34, 13.
कृच्छ्र—वर्तिन् mfn. performing a penance, Kām.
कृच्छ्र—शस् ind. with difficulty, scarcely, Kāṭh. xxv, 2.
कृच्छ्र—संवत्सर m. N. of a penance lasting one year, Āp.
कृच्छ्र—साध्य mfn. to be done with difficulty, Mcar.
curable with difficulty, Suśr.
N. of a penance (taking no sustenance but water for 3, 9, 12, or 21 days), Gaut. xxvi, 20; Yājñ. iii, 321
du. the ordinary and the extraordinary penance, Gaut. xix, 20; Mn. xi, 208.
freed from trouble, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 39 and vi, 3, 2, Kāś.
gained with difficulty.
= कृच्छ्र-संवत्सर, Gaut.
‘enemy of pain’, removing ischury, N. of a plant (a species of Bilva), L.
an inferior penance lasting only six days, Āp.
कृच्छ्री-√ भू to become embarrassed, ChUp. v, 3, 7.
undergoing danger, RV. vi, 75, 9.
कृच्छ्—˚रोद्य mfn. difficult to be pronounced, Kāvyād.
a disease of the eye-lids, ŚārṅgS.
encompassed with difficulties, being in trouble, feeling pain g. सुखादि
